corrective_core_mvp.exit_gate: All 145.1-145.50 steps resolved or explicitly blocked/deferred with evidence; Core MVP vertical slice and data-safety gates green.

sequential_expansion.resume_condition: corrective_core_mvp exit_gate is satisfied and recorded.

precedence: A corrective sprint overrides feature expansion until its exit gate passes.
Exactly one mutation stream may be ACTIVE.
External sprint JSON defines requirements; repository ledger defines implementation evidence.
Runtime state is a disposable cache and may be repaired only from policy, canonical JSON, and ledger consensus.
Missing or conflicting evidence blocks mutation; it never authorizes invented scope.
A document without a sprint number cannot create scope; its role and authority must come from DOCUMENT_REGISTRY.json.
protected_core: novel, chapter, scene, character, and core lore data
autosave, snapshots, backup, restore, import, and export
deferred_until_core_gate: XR, metaverse, and non-Core production expansion
